name: kubik
description: A free artist, a shared frame, and dice: a design skill for landing pages, reports, slide decks, pages of figures and design systems that do not come out looking alike, and a words skill that writes for the person who reads.

interface.shortDescription: Design skill with a frame, a method and dice
interface.longDescription: Makes landing pages, reports, slide decks, pages of figures and design systems that do not look alike. It listens to what the person wants to see, throws dice for whatever they left open, picks a concept and draws it, inside one frame: what the reader needs. Every piece is opened in a real browser and checked before it is handed over.
defaultPrompt: Make a landing page for this project.
Turn these findings into a report.
Make a design system for our back office.
